slides.title: On the Farm
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 1 English, Unit 5: On the Farm. In this unit you will learn about the farm. You will name the farm animals and the sounds they make, learn farm words like tractor, barn and field, and talk about the work people do on a farm — feeding, planting and picking. You will see how animals and plants grow: a chick from an egg, a bean from a seed. You will hear a gentle story about helping and working hard. Say the words out loud — this is about speaking with confidence, not perfect spelling. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Name common farm animals (cow, hen, chick, duck, sheep, goat, horse…).
Say the sound each animal makes (moo, cluck, quack, baa…).
Name farm places and things (farm, barn, field, tractor, egg, seed).
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to name common farm animals (cow, hen, chick, duck, sheep, goat, horse…) You will also say the sound each animal makes (moo, cluck, quack, baa…) You will also name farm places and things (farm, barn, field, tractor, egg, seed). Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: sun, cup, bus, fun, bun, nut. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes Amal and the Little Hen and Talk about On the Farm. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Name a farm animal
bullets: Name one farm animal. Say 'a' before most words, but 'an' before a vowel sound: a cow, an ox.
Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Name a farm animal. Name one farm animal. Say 'a' before most words, but 'an' before a vowel sound: a cow, an ox. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 - Listen and point. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
